Usage: rig proof add [options] <slice-path>

Drop a proof artifact: authors the C1 frontmatter from flags, writes
<slice>/proof/<name>, echoes the parsed header. Contract/self-check/C8 outputs
are advisories (exit 0) — never gates.

Options:
  --mission <name>         Hint mission when slice-path is just NN-slug
  --artifact-type <type>   C1 artifact_type, one of: guard | qa | rev1-r1 |
                           rev1-r2 | adjudication
  --verdict <verdict>      C1 verdict, one of: CLEAR | BLOCKING | CONCERNING |
                           PASS | NOT-CLEAR
  --candidate-sha <sha>    C1 candidate_sha — the join key (convention C2): the
                           proven candidate tip this artifact judges
  --money-evidence <line>  C1 money_evidence — the one line of money evidence
  --slice-id <dot-id>      C1 slice dot-ID (defaults to the slice frontmatter
                           id)
  --file <path>            Artifact body from a file (mutually exclusive with
                           --body)
  --body <text>            Artifact body inline (mutually exclusive with --file)
  --name <filename>        Markdown artifact filename in proof/ (defaults to the
                           --file stem plus .md, else
                           <artifact-type>-<verdict>-<UTC>.md)
  --replace                Explicitly replace an existing Markdown artifact
  --evidences <refs>       D2 attestation: comma-separated proof-contract item
                           refs this artifact covers (item text or 1-based
                           index)
  --self-check <text>      D2 attestation: the agent's assertion that it LOOKED
                           at the evidence and confirmed it shows the claim
  --media <refs>           Corrective §3.4: comma-separated media refs (relative
                           to the slice proof/ dir) this drop stands behind —
                           appended to the artifact body as markdown refs so the
                           composer curates them into delivered.items[].proof
  --json                   JSON output for agents
  -h, --help               display help for command
